1.0 保持原始对比。调高可加强深浅区别；调低更柔和，但细线可能变淡。: 1.0 keeps the original contrast. Increase for stronger light and dark areas; decrease for a softer look, which may fade fine lines.
1.0 保持原始色彩，0 为灰度；调高更鲜艳，过高可能丢失柔和的颜色层次。: 1.0 keeps the original colors; 0 is grayscale. Increase for vivid colors, but high values can flatten subtle shades.
32 色较容易备料，64 色层次更丰富。均为屏幕参考色，不代表任何实体品牌的官方: 32 colors are easier to prepare; 64 offer more shading. These are screen reference colors, not official colors of a bead brand.
CSV 没有表头。: The CSV has no header row.
CSV 需要 hex 列，或同时提供 r、g、b 三列。: The CSV needs a hex column or all three r, g, b columns.
Excel 导出最多支持 300 × 300 格。: Excel export supports grids up to 300 × 300.
Excel 导出需要非空二维像素矩阵。: Excel export requires a nonempty two-dimensional pixel array.
HEX 与 RGB 不一致：{code}: HEX and RGB do not match: {code}
PDF 将生成 {grid_pages} 页网格，另附色号统计页；各页格子大小一: The PDF will have {grid_pages} grid pages plus a color summary. Cell sizes stay consistent across pages.
PDF 每页行列数必须是正整数。: PDF rows and columns per page must be positive integers.
RGB 必须在 0–255 之间: RGB values must be between 0 and 255
hex 必须是 6 位颜色值: hex must be a six-digit color value
上传一幅画，设置拼豆数量和色库，即可生成可制作、可统计、可打印的拼豆图。: Upload an image, choose the bead count and palette, and create a printable pattern with a materials list.
两图同步缩放；适应窗口可查看完整图片，放大后可在各自框内横向、纵向滚动。仅调整预: Both previews zoom together. Fit to window shows the full image; at higher zoom, scroll within each frame. This only affects the preview, not downloads.
保持比例并保留整张原图，空余区域使用下方选择的背景色。: Keep the aspect ratio and the entire image. Empty space uses the background color below.
保持比例并填满网格，超出部分会从四周居中裁掉。: Keep the aspect ratio and fill the grid, cropping the outer edges around the center.
像素矩阵含无效色库索引。: The pixel array contains invalid palette indices.
像素矩阵必须包含整数色库索引。: The pixel array must contain integer palette indices.
先上传一张原画。可以先用默认参数生成，再根据效果调整左侧设置。: Upload an image to begin. Try the defaults, then adjust the settings to refine the result.
先在右侧上传原画，再调整参数并生成。: Upload an image, adjust the settings, then generate the pattern.
列出色号、数量和占比，可用于备料和核对；不包含网格图。: Lists color codes, counts and percentages for preparing materials. Does not include the grid image.
加强嘴部、帽檐等细暗线，建议从 0.65 开始。照片或纹理较多时可调为 0，避免: Strengthens thin dark lines, such as mouths and hat edges. Start at 0.65; use 0 for photos or textures if noise becomes stronger.
包含所有图纸、色号表与本次生成设置，方便保存和分享。: Includes all patterns, color lists and generation settings for saving or sharing.
只使用勾选品牌的颜色进行匹配，可多选；至少选择一个品牌。: Use only colors from the selected brands. Select one or more brands.
只调整 PNG 图纸中格子和文字的大小，不增加图案细节；大网格会自动限制渲染尺寸: Changes cell and text size in the PNG, not image detail. Large grids automatically limit the rendered size.
可用颜色数必须在 1–{MAX_PALETTE_COLORS} 之间: Usable color count must be between 1 and {MAX_PALETTE_COLORS}
品牌色卡按对应品牌色号配色，已随程序内置；也可使用通用色、自动取色或导入自己的色: Brand palettes use their own color codes and are bundled with the app. You can also use generic colors, extract colors or import a palette.
品牌色卡无法读取，请确认程序的 data/brand_palettes 文件夹完: Cannot read the brand palette. Check that data/brand_palettes is included in the app folder.
图片像素超过 8000 万，请先缩小图片。: The image exceeds 80 million pixels. Resize it before uploading.
图片超过 60 MB，请先压缩后再上传。: The image exceeds 60 MB. Compress it before uploading.
图纸已就绪。备份或分享选 ZIP；打印制作选 PDF；逐格查看选 Excel。: Your pattern is ready. Choose ZIP to save or share, PDF to print, or Excel to inspect individual cells.
图纸页数较多，生成和打印需要更长时间，可选择更密的分页规格。: This pattern has many pages. Generation and printing may take longer; use more cells per page to reduce the page count.
填充透明像素和构图留白，随后参与配色。这些区域仍需要拼豆，不会成为空格。: Fills transparent pixels and layout margins before color matching. These areas still require beads; they are not empty cells.
增强缩小后的局部边缘，建议从 0.25 开始；0 为关闭。过高可能出现硬边或光晕: Sharpens edges after resizing. Start at 0.25; 0 disables it. High values may create harsh edges or halos and cannot recover all detail.
宽和高需要在 4–300 颗之间。: Width and height must be between 4 and 300 beads.
已手动选择，优先于自动识别。: Your manual selection overrides automatic detection.
已选 {v0} / {v1} 个可用色号。可取消自己没有的分组，生成时只使用所选: Selected {v0} of {v1} usable colors. Deselect groups you do not own; only selected colors will be used.
带坐标和网格的图片，适合屏幕查看或分享。: A grid image with coordinates, suitable for viewing or sharing.
开启后按原图比例计算高度；关闭后可分别设置宽高。自动高度仍限制在 4–300 颗: Calculate height from the image aspect ratio. Turn off to set width and height separately. Automatic height is limited to 4–300 beads.
当前使用浏览器语言：{language}；IP 不可用时保持此语言。: Using browser language: {language}. This remains the fallback if IP lookup is unavailable.
当前纵向：{rows} 颗，由原图比例自动计算。: Current height: {rows} beads, calculated from the image aspect ratio.
所选色号分组不属于当前色卡。: The selected color groups do not belong to this palette.
把原图强制铺满指定宽高；比例不一致时，人物或物体会变形。: Stretch the image to fill the specified size. A different aspect ratio will distort subjects.
按所选网格密度分页，附色号用量统计，适合打印制作。: Paginated at the selected grid density, with color counts for printing and assembly.
控制 PNG、PDF 和 Excel 格内的色号。关闭后保留色块，用量统计仍然包: Show color codes inside PNG, PDF and Excel cells. Turning this off keeps color fills; the materials list always includes full codes.
支持 1–512 色。使用 brand、code、name、hex 列，或用 r: Supports 1–512 colors. Use brand, code, name and hex columns, or r, g, b instead of hex. Start with the downloadable template.
支持 JPG、PNG、WEBP 等常见图片，每张最多 60 MB；GIF 只取第: Supports JPG, PNG, WEBP and other common formats, up to 60 MB each. GIF uses the first frame. Generate again after replacing the image.
支持常见图片格式；GIF 使用第一帧。: Common image formats are supported; GIF uses the first frame.
数据为公开整理的屏幕参考色，不代表品牌官方实测值。: These publicly compiled screen colors are references, not official brand measurements.
无法读取这张图片，请使用 JPG、PNG、WEBP、BMP、TIFF 或 GIF: Cannot read this image. Use JPG, PNG, WEBP, BMP, TIFF or GIF.
未找到所选品牌色卡。: The selected brand palette was not found.
此版已排除 {v0} 条未确认色号，不会出现在图纸或采购统计中。: This version excludes {v0} unconfirmed codes from patterns and materials lists.
每 5 颗拼豆显示一条粗网格线。: Major grid lines appear every 5 beads.
每页格子越少，色号越大、页数越多。PDF 各页比例一致，但不是按拼豆直径 1:1: Fewer cells per page mean larger codes and more pages. PDF pages share the same scale, but are not printed at actual bead size.
每项参数下方都有说明。可以收起暂时不用的分组，调整后点击生成。: Each setting has an explanation below it. Collapse sections you do not need, then generate your pattern.
每颗拼豆对应一个单元格，从 A1 开始；附生成时的色号用量统计。格内色号沿用生成: One bead per cell, starting at A1, with a snapshot of color counts. In-cell codes follow your generation settings.
用于估算实物尺寸：颗数 × 直径。不改变图像清晰度，也不控制 PDF 的实际打印: Estimates finished size as bead count × diameter. It does not change image detail or the printed PDF cell size.
细线保留和锐化强度需要在 0–1 之间。: Line preservation and sharpness must be between 0 and 1.
自动模式通过 Country.is 查询 IP 地区；图片不参与查询。: Automatic mode looks up your IP region with Country.is. Images are never included in the lookup.
至少需要一个颜色。: At least one color is required.
色卡为公开整理的屏幕参考色；透明、夜光等特殊材质的效果请对照实物。单颗直径请按实: Palettes contain publicly compiled screen reference colors. Check physical beads for transparent or glow effects, and enter the actual bead diameter.
色号、品牌或名称含 Excel 不支持的控制字符，或长度超过 32767。: A code, brand or name contains unsupported Excel control characters or exceeds 32,767 characters.
色号必须为非空文本: Color codes must be nonempty text
色号表最多支持 {MAX_PALETTE_COLORS} 个颜色。: A palette file supports up to {MAX_PALETTE_COLORS} colors.
色号表编码无法识别，请另存为 UTF-8 CSV。: Cannot detect the palette encoding. Save it as UTF-8 CSV.
色号表至少需要一个有效颜色。: The palette file needs at least one valid color.
色库最多支持 {MAX_PALETTE_COLORS} 个颜色。: A palette supports up to {MAX_PALETTE_COLORS} colors.
范围 4–300 颗。越多越能保留细节，但用豆量和成品宽度也会增加。: Range: 4–300 beads. More beads preserve more detail but increase materials and finished width.
范围 4–300 颗，控制图案高度；上传图片并锁定比例后，此值将自动计算。: Range: 4–300 beads. Sets pattern height; with an image and locked aspect ratio, height is calculated automatically.
设置或色库已变化，请重新生成拼豆图后下载。: Settings or palette changed. Generate a new pattern before downloading.
设置最多提取的颜色数，实际可能更少。颜色越多层次越丰富；自动色需自行寻找近似实体: Sets the maximum number of extracted colors; fewer may be found. More colors add shading, but you must find physical beads that match.
请先导入有效的 CSV 色号表。: Import a valid palette CSV first.
请至少选择一个包含有效颜色的品牌。: Select at least one brand with valid colors.
请至少选择一个色号分组。: Select at least one color group.
请选择有效的品牌色卡和色号分组。: Select a valid brand palette and color groups.
请重新生成拼豆图，以启用新增的 Excel 下载。: Generate the pattern again to enable Excel download.
调整设置后点击“生成拼豆图”。: Adjust the settings, then click “Generate pattern”.
滚轮或按钮缩放，拖动查看细节；按 Esc 关闭。: Use the wheel or buttons to zoom; drag to pan. Press Esc to close.
点击“放大查看”或图纸可缩放、拖动查看；每 5 颗一条粗线，顶部与左侧为坐标。: Click Enlarge view or the pattern to zoom and pan. Bold lines mark every 5 beads; coordinates appear along the top and left.
